name: Camtech (SA)
summary: University of Adelaide-owned IT/ISP company; sold its SA internet business to OzEmail March 1998.

events.details: Established as University of Adelaide company (reportedly Campus Technologies); AARNet VAR from 1994. 1983 founding predates the archive and is unverified; earliest Wayback capture 31 Oct 1996 (camtech.com.au).
OzEmail acquired Camtech's SA internet service business (31 March 1998); Camtech itself continued as an IT company (camtech.com.au live to ~2011).
